# duckduckgo-search-cli

- Rust CLI for DuckDuckGo search — returns results as JSON, Markdown, or plain text
- Install with: `cargo install duckduckgo-search-cli --locked`
- Current version: **v1.0.2**
- Repository: https://github.com/danilo-aguiar-br/duckduckgo-search-cli
- Production transport: **Chrome-only** chromiumoxide/CDP (GAP-WS-113). Without Chrome → exit 2 fail-closed.
- No remote telemetry. Product config = **CLI + XDG only** (no product env knobs).


## What's new in v1.0.2 (2026-07)

- **ADR-0027:** serialize wire keys are **English** (`results`, `title`, `metadata`, `result_count`, `used_chrome`, `chrome_channel`, `chrome_path_resolved`, `execution_time_ms`, `news`, `searches`, `query_count`, `error`/`message`/`type`, …).
- Deserialize still accepts Portuguese aliases (fixtures/legacy).
- **`--wire-keys en|pt`** + XDG `wire_keys` — emit-boundary remap for legacy PT (`--wire-keys pt` or `config set wire_keys pt`).
- **Agent ops:** `--fields`/`--select`, `--filter`, `--sort`, `--dedupe-by`, `--limit`, `--count-only`, `--truncate-content`, `--max-output-bytes`.
- **RuntimeConfig SSOT:** CLI > XDG > FACTORY (`src/runtime/`).
- **`budget_profile`:** `lab` | `desktop_contended` | `thin`.
- **`chrome_session_retries`:** CLI + XDG process-wide SERP launch retries.
- **no-warmup fail-closed:** `--no-warmup` needs hidden `--allow-no-warmup` or XDG `allow_no_warmup=true`.
- **Linux cgroup opt-in:** `linux_cgroup_enabled` + `linux_cgroup_memory_max_mb`.
- **ADR-0026 mute-audio** mandatory on every Chrome launch (MUTE-002 fixed quad-dash argv; no unmute).
- **Budget dual/contention (ADR-0025):** dual multiproc estimate, `--print-budget`, `--auto-contention-budget` (default ON), doctor `ready_for_dual_deep_research`.
- Defaults: `--max-sub-queries 3`, `--fetch-content-cap 4`; deep grace timeout **20s**.
- Fail-fast exit 2 on `budget_underflow` unless `--allow-under-budget`.
- Migration: `docs/MIGRATION.md` · `docs/MIGRATION.pt-BR.md`.


## What's new in v1.0.1 (2026-07-19) — Pass 52 agent contract

- Multi-query `--stream` / `-f ndjson` **IMPLEMENTED** — NDJSON lines of `SearchOutput` as each query completes (single-query ignores with warning).
- Dual `config` API: positional or `--key`/`--value`; `config effective` shows CLI > XDG > defaults.
- Broken pipe → exit **141**; Unix SIGPIPE stays **SIG_IGN** so oneshot reap still runs.
- Wire JSON: Portuguese serialize (1.x) + English deserialize aliases (**ADR-0023**) — **superseded serialize default by v1.0.2 EN**.
- Chrome-only CDP; no remote telemetry.


## Commands (full inventory)

```
duckduckgo-search-cli [OPTIONS] [QUERY]... [COMMAND]

Commands:
  init-config                          Write selectors.toml + user-agents.toml to XDG
  completions <SHELL>                  Shell completions (bash/zsh/fish/…)
  deep-research [OPTIONS] [QUERY]      Fan-out, aggregate, optional synthesis
  commands                             Full command tree as JSON (agent discovery)
  schema [--name NAME]                 JSON Schema catalog or named body
  doctor [--strict] [--probe-deep]
  locale                               Resolved UI locale JSON
  man [--file PATH]                    roff man page from clap tree
  config path|list|get|set|unset|effective
  help
  (hidden) buscar                      Equivalent to default search mode
```

### One-liner examples

```bash
# Default search (EN wire)
duckduckgo-search-cli -q -f json "rust async" | jaq '.results[].url'

# Agent ops (no jaq required)
duckduckgo-search-cli "rust async" -q -f json \
  --fields url,title --filter 'title~async' --sort title --limit 5
duckduckgo-search-cli "rust async" -q -f json --count-only
duckduckgo-search-cli "rust async" -q -f json --wire-keys pt

# deep-research + budget dry-run
duckduckgo-search-cli deep-research --print-budget -q
duckduckgo-search-cli deep-research "tokio vs async-std 2026" -q -f json \
  | jaq '.results[] | {title, url, score}'

# Discovery / diagnostics
duckduckgo-search-cli init-config --force
duckduckgo-search-cli completions bash
duckduckgo-search-cli commands -q
duckduckgo-search-cli schema --name search-output
duckduckgo-search-cli --print-schema
duckduckgo-search-cli doctor -q
duckduckgo-search-cli doctor --strict
duckduckgo-search-cli doctor --probe-deep -q
duckduckgo-search-cli --probe -q
duckduckgo-search-cli locale -q
duckduckgo-search-cli man | man -l -

# config CRUD (RuntimeConfig SSOT)
duckduckgo-search-cli config path
duckduckgo-search-cli config list
duckduckgo-search-cli config get wire_keys
duckduckgo-search-cli config set budget_profile desktop_contended
duckduckgo-search-cli config set chrome_session_retries 2
duckduckgo-search-cli config set wire_keys en
duckduckgo-search-cli config unset proxy_url
duckduckgo-search-cli config effective
```


## Wire JSON (v1.0.2 default EN)

Top-level (single search): `query`, `engine`, `endpoint`, `region`, `result_count`, `results[]`, `news[]`, `news_count`, `metadata`, `pages_fetched`.

Result row: `position`, `title`, `url`, `display_url`, `snippet`, optional `content` / `content_size`.

Metadata (agent, **not** telemetry): `used_chrome`, `chrome_channel` (`host`|`flatpak`|`snap`|`manual`), `chrome_path_resolved`, `execution_time_ms`, `result_count`, `identity_used`, `zero_cause`, `next_action_suggestion`, …

Multi-query: `searches[]` / `query_count` (not `buscas`/`quantidade_queries` on default EN).

Deep: `kind`, optional `partial`, `sub_queries_total`/`ok`/`error`, `sources`, `synth` (when `--synthesize`).

Thin errors: `error`, `message`, `type`.

Legacy PT: `--wire-keys pt` or `config set wire_keys pt`.

| 1.x PT | 1.0.2 EN |
|--------|--------|
| `resultados` | `results` |
| `titulo` | `title` |
| `metadados` | `metadata` |
| `quantidade_resultados` | `result_count` |
| `usou_chrome` | `used_chrome` |
| `chrome_canal` | `chrome_channel` |
| `chrome_path_resolvido` | `chrome_path_resolved` |
| `tempo_execucao_ms` | `execution_time_ms` |
| `noticias` | `news` |
| `buscas` | `searches` |
| `sintese` | `synth` |


## Canonical jaq (EN wire)

```bash
duckduckgo-search-cli -q -f json "query" | jaq '.results | length'
duckduckgo-search-cli -q -f json "query" | jaq -r '.results[].url'
duckduckgo-search-cli -q -f json "query" | jaq -r '.metadata.used_chrome // false'
duckduckgo-search-cli -q -f json "query" | jaq -r '.metadata.chrome_channel // "n/a"'
duckduckgo-search-cli -q -f json "one" "two" | jaq '.searches[0].results | length'
duckduckgo-search-cli -q -f json deep-research "query" | jaq '.results[] | {title, url, score}'
```


## Exit codes

| Code | Meaning | Agent action |
|------|---------|--------------|
| `0` | Success | Parse `.results` |
| `1` | Runtime error | Read stderr; retry once with `-v` |
| `2` | Config / no Chrome / budget_underflow | Install Chrome; fix flags; `--print-budget` / `--allow-under-budget` |
| `3` | Anti-bot block | Back off 300+ s; Chrome / `--chrome-path` / `--proxy` |
| `4` | Global timeout | Raise `--global-timeout`; reduce `--parallel` |
| `5` | Zero results | Refine query or change `--lang` |
| `6` | Suspected block | Inspect `.metadata.zero_cause`; wait 300s |
| `141` | Broken pipe | Consumer closed (`\| head`); not a search failure |


## Anti-patterns

- NEVER parse `text` or `markdown` with machines (use `json` + agent ops or `jaq`)
- NEVER omit outer `timeout` (pipelines hang indefinitely)
- NEVER use `.resultados` / `.metadados` on **v1.0.2** default wire (use `.results` / `.metadata` or `--wire-keys pt`)
- NEVER treat `--stream` as a full SERP hit stream (multi-query NDJSON only)
- NEVER raise `--parallel` above 5 casually (anti-bot risk)
- NEVER pass long-lived proxy secrets in argv if avoidable (prefer XDG `proxy_url`; userinfo stripped from Chrome argv in 1.0.2)


## Key flags (root)

`--num`/`-n`, `--format`/`-f`, `--output`/`-o`, `--lang`/`-l`, `--country`/`-c`, `--parallel`/`-p`,
`--vertical` (default **`all`**), `--fetch-content` / `--no-fetch-content`, `--fetch-content-cap` (default **4**),
`--stream` / `-f ndjson`, `--global-timeout` (default **180**), `--proxy` / `--no-proxy`, `--chrome-path`,
`--probe`, `--probe-deep`, `--pre-flight`, `--wire-keys`, `--fields`/`--select`, `--filter`, `--sort`,
`--dedupe-by`, `--limit`, `--count-only`, `--truncate-content`, `--max-output-bytes`, `--chrome-session-retries`,
`--no-warmup` (fail-closed without allow), `-q`, `-v`/`-vv`.

Deep-research extras: `--print-budget`, `--budget-tokens`, `--max-sub-queries` (default **3**), `--aggregate`,
`--synthesize`, `--synth-format`, `--depth`, `--allow-under-budget`, `--auto-contention-budget` /
`--no-auto-contention-budget`, `--require-all-sub-queries`, `--no-news`, `--sub-queries-file`.
